title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke University on 1982-04-02
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2025 > DDi Codec (dolby B) > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics (w/ Bass EQ) > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Excellent DDi‑enhanced soundboard capture featuring a monstrous He's Gone > Truckin' > The Other One sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording benefits from the DDi codec, delivering crisp, clear audio that lets listeners enjoy a truly monster performance of He’s Gone into Truckin’ and The Other One. Reviewers praise the high‑energy playing and consider this stretch worth hearing despite the lack of other detail about the show.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 5‑star review highlights both a stellar performance (high energy, standout songs) and superior recording quality thanks to the DDi codec.

recording_quality.technical_notes: DDi codec provides crystal‑clear, balanced sound; reviewers note the recording needed it and now sounds great.
